title: A group module named in extensions.backlog_commands adds a backlog.py command or replaces a shipped one through bl_cli.register, and backlog.py -h marks it as the group's
goal: backlog.py imports each module extensions.backlog_commands lists through kbext after the shipped modules; a module's bl_cli.register adds a command; a module's bl_cli.register or bl_cli.extend of a shipped command's name replaces it and prints one stderr line naming the command, the module and the layer each time it runs; backlog.py -h lists a group command with the group name in its help; a module that fails to load is named on stderr while the shipped commands run as before

gates.question: How does bl_cli import the modules extensions.backlog_commands lists, when kbext.resolve and kbext.load take one module:attr string and kbext.py is outside this item's touches?
options: bl_cli.load_group_commands reads the list through the public kbsettings.layered and kbsettings.layer_files, puts extension_paths on sys.path and checks KBEXT_REQUIRES against kbext.API_VERSION and kbext.BOUND_RE itself, until kbext.py has a public loader of a list
Wait for kbext.py to gain a public loader of a list (kbext.py is outside this item's touches), and call it
gates.recommendation: bl_cli.load_group_commands reads the list through the public kbsettings.layered and kbsettings.layer_files, puts extension_paths on sys.path and checks KBEXT_REQUIRES against kbext.API_VERSION and kbext.BOUND_RE itself, until kbext.py has a public loader of a list
gates.answer: call the public kbext.load_all(point, root) from ST-k2jjwnew; copy no loader logic into bl_cli; the orchestrator rebases this branch onto origin/main once ST-k2jjwnew lands

gates.question: When one module of extensions.backlog_commands fails to load, what happens to the commands it registered and to the modules after it?
options: What it registered before failing is taken back, it is named on stderr with its layer, and the modules after it still load
The first failing module ends the loading and the modules after it are not tried
gates.recommendation: What it registered before failing is taken back, it is named on stderr with its layer, and the modules after it still load
gates.answer: What it registered before failing is taken back, it is named on stderr with its layer, and the modules after it still load

gates.question: Given kbext.load_all stops at the first module it refuses, what happens to the commands that the group's modules registered when one module fails to load (this settles g3 anew)?
options: Every command the group's modules registered is taken back, the failing module is named on stderr and the shipped commands run as before
Keep the commands of the modules that loaded before the failing one
gates.recommendation: Every command the group's modules registered is taken back, the failing module is named on stderr and the shipped commands run as before
